blockers.title: Undefined Physical Microgrid Fallback Policy
blockers.description: No authorized operational policy defines exact microgrid hardware setpoints when automatic MILP optimization returns infeasibility.
blockers.mitigation_required: Governance must define whether microgrid holds last setpoint, falls back to local hardware governors, or shedding non-critical load.

blockers.title: Un-Governed Constraint Relaxation Hierarchy
blockers.description: If constraint relaxation (Option C) is desired, no policy exists specifying relaxation order, maximum penalty bounds, or soft vs hard boundaries.
blockers.mitigation_required: Formal governance authorization of constraint priority sequence and maximum violation limits.

blockers.title: Unimplemented Operator Manual Takeover Interface
blockers.description: Option E (Operator Intervention) cannot be executed because no operator API, manual override UI, or authority transfer interlock exists in POLARIS.
blockers.mitigation_required: Specification and buildout of operator control interface and audit logging system.

blockers.title: Runner Pre-Existing State Advancement Conflict
blockers.description: Runner currently sets state_advanced=True and commits zero dispatch on OPTIMIZATION_INFEASIBLE, violating the frozen MILP_INFEASIBILITY_STATE_ADVANCEMENT = MUST_NOT_OCCUR policy.
blockers.mitigation_required: Authorized code modification to runner.py to halt state advancement upon MILP infeasibility after governance policy selection.
